title: Online bookshop: delivery fees and checkout
question: How might different users react if this online store changes its delivery fees, free-delivery threshold and checkout flow?

quote.text: The marketing manager has proposed raising the free-delivery threshold from £30 to £40, replacing the flat fee with a fee that depends on delivery speed, and moving to a one-page checkout that shows delivery options earlier.
Finance has asked for a version that keeps the threshold and adds a paid membership instead.

participants.name: Customer support team

quote.text: The support lead expects a short rise in tickets after any change to fees or checkout and has no spare capacity before the autumn peak.

participants.rationale: Takes the tickets after a change.

quote.text: Warehouse employees say that orders pushed up to a higher threshold tend to hold more items and take longer to pack.
The carriers, which the shop treats as delivery partners, say that fee tiers by speed would need a change to their rate cards, and one has hinted at a surcharge for peak weeks.

participants.name: Payments provider

quote.text: The payments provider needs notice before a checkout change goes live.

participants.rationale: Needs notice for a checkout change.

quote.text: The web developer notes that a one-page checkout has not been tested with screen readers or keyboard-only navigation, and the accessibility review that would normally come first has not been scheduled.
Regulators take an interest in charges that appear only on the final page.
A few regular customers asked for a paid membership with free delivery.
Gift buyers care more about a delivery date than about the fee.

participants.name: Students buying course books

quote.text: Students buying course books said a single-title order rarely reaches the threshold.

participants.rationale: Single-title orders rarely reach the threshold.

quote.text: Several people in remote areas said surcharges are common elsewhere and sometimes appear as a surprise at the last step.
Free delivery above £20 on items the marketplace sells itself; third-party sellers set their own fees.

quote.text: The web developer notes that a one-page checkout has not been tested with screen readers or keyboard-only navigation, and the accessibility review that would normally come first has not been scheduled.

participants.rationale: Named only as not yet tested.
